senses.gloss: m. (παράδειγμα, ατος) an example, exposure to public shame. Tanḥ., ed. Bub., Lekh 7 (ref. to II Sam. X, 4) ועשה אותם פ׳ and made them a public disgrace; Yalk. Ps. 730 פדרגימט׳ (corr. acc.).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 249:1">Yalk. Kings 249</cite> <he>החזיר אותו בכל ערי בפרדימא … וקרע את החמור וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>בפרדימס</he>, corr. acc.) he carried him around all cities of Israel as a public shame, and then put him to death, and took the ass and tore it open and buried &c.; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite> <he>וישב עליו בפרדימ׳</he>.
